title: HubSpot vs SuiteCRM
comparison_markdown:
# HubSpot vs SuiteCRM

## Overview

All-in-one CRM, marketing, sales, and customer service platform. is a popular proprietary tool in the productivity space. SuiteCRM is a free, open-source alternative that gives organizations complete control over their data and deployment.

## Key Differences

- **Cost**: HubSpot costs Free / $15-$800+/month; SuiteCRM is Free (self-hosted)
- **License**: HubSpot is Proprietary; SuiteCRM is AGPL 3.0
- **Data ownership**: SuiteCRM can be self-hosted so your data stays on infrastructure you control
- **Vendor lock-in**: SuiteCRM eliminates dependency on a single commercial vendor
- **Community**: SuiteCRM has an active open-source community contributing features and fixes

## Pricing Comparison

| Aspect | HubSpot | SuiteCRM |
|--------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| Base pricing | Free / $15-$800+/month | Free (self-hosted) |
| License | Proprietary | AGPL 3.0 |
| Self-hosting | Not available | Available |
| Cost at 50 users | See pricing page | $0/month (self-hosted) |
| Cost at 200 users | See pricing page | $0/month (self-hosted) |
| Vendor lock-in | High | None |

## Pros and Cons

### HubSpot

**Pros:**
- Polished, professionally designed user interface
- Large ecosystem of official integrations
- Managed infrastructure with no server maintenance required
- Enterprise SLA and dedicated support available
- Mobile apps are well-maintained and reliable

**Cons:**
- Significant per-user monthly cost that scales linearly with team size
- Your data is stored on the vendor infrastructure
- No ability to inspect or modify the source code
- Feature roadmap controlled entirely by the vendor
- Risk of pricing changes, acquisition, or discontinuation

### SuiteCRM

**Pros:**
- Free to self-host with costs only for server infrastructure
- Complete data ownership and privacy control
- Source code is auditable and modifiable
- Active open-source community
- No vendor lock-in or risk of sudden pricing changes
> GitHub: [salesagility/SuiteCRM](https://github.com/salesagility/SuiteCRM) * ~4k stars

**Cons:**
- Requires technical knowledge to self-host and maintain
- May lack some advanced features found in the proprietary version
- Support relies on community forums rather than a paid helpdesk
- UI polish may lag behind the proprietary tool
- You are responsible for updates, backups, and security patches

## When to Choose Each

**Choose HubSpot if:** HubSpot is the right choice when you need the most polished user experience, the broadest integration ecosystem, and professional support with SLA guarantees.

**Choose SuiteCRM if:** SuiteCRM is ideal for privacy-conscious teams, organizations with strict data sovereignty requirements, or anyone wanting to eliminate per-seat subscription costs.

## Migration Path

Export your data from HubSpot in its standard export format, review SuiteCRM import documentation, and plan a pilot period where both tools run in parallel.

## Our Take

SuiteCRM is production-ready for most teams willing to invest a few hours in setup. The self-hosted version gives you identical or better functionality to the paid HubSpot tiers, with no recurring per-seat cost.

The main technical limitation worth knowing: you are responsible for your own backups, updates, and uptime. If your server goes down, so does your SuiteCRM instance. Plan for this with automated backups and a monitoring alert.

Our recommendation: if your team has at least one developer and you are paying more than $100/month for HubSpot, switching to self-hosted SuiteCRM will pay for itself within the first month. If nobody on your team is comfortable with Linux or Docker, stay on HubSpot until you have that resource.

## Who Should Switch

- Startups under 20 people paying per-seat fees they cannot yet justify
- Dev teams who already self-host other tools and have the ops knowledge
- Organizations in jurisdictions with strict data residency requirements
- Teams who have evaluated HubSpot paid features and only use the basics
- Founders and solopreneurs who want the functionality without the subscription

## FAQ

### Is SuiteCRM free to use?
Yes. SuiteCRM is free to self-host. Your only cost is the server, typically $6-$12/month on a VPS provider like DigitalOcean or Vultr.

### How hard is it to migrate from HubSpot to SuiteCRM?
For most teams, migration takes 2-4 hours. Export your HubSpot data, follow the SuiteCRM import guide, and test with a small group before switching everyone over.

### Does SuiteCRM get regular updates?
Yes. SuiteCRM has an active open-source community with regular releases. Check the GitHub repository for release frequency.

### Can I use SuiteCRM without technical knowledge?
You need basic comfort with a VPS and command line. If that feels unfamiliar, there are managed hosting options that handle the server for you at a modest cost.

### What happens if SuiteCRM development stops?
Because the source code is open, you can continue running whatever version you have indefinitely. You can also fork the project or switch to another tool at your own pace — no vendor can shut off your instance.

---
*Data sourced July 2026. Pricing and features change. Verify at [HubSpot](https://hubspot.com) and [SuiteCRM](https://suitecrm.com) before making decisions.*
meta_description: SuiteCRM is a free, self-hosted alternative to HubSpot. Compare pricing, features, and migration steps. See full comparison.
